eea_co2_de.name: EEA Monitoring of CO2 emissions from passenger cars (Reg. (EU) 2019/631) - Germany aggregate by make/model/fuel
eea_co2_de.license: EEA standard re-use policy (free re-use with attribution), Directive 2003/98/EC
eea_co2_de.fields_used: Mk, Cn, Ft, Year, count, avg Ewltp (WLTP CO2 g/km), Z (Wh/km), Fc (l/100km), Ep (kW), M (kg), Ec (cm3)
eea_co2_de.notes: Per-registration records aggregated server-side to make/model/fuel for the latest final year in the 'latest' table (2022 at retrieval; provisional 2023/2024 are separate EEA releases). Used for spec anchors (consumption, CO2, power, mass); current volumes come from KBA. BEV electric range is not in the public per-vehicle table; range anchors use manufacturer WLTP figures curated in de/curated_ev_range.json.

urls.co2cars_agg.json: sql:SELECT Mk, Cn, Ft, Year, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG([Ewltp (g/km)]) AS co2_wltp_g_km, AVG([Erwltp (g/km)]) AS co2_reduction_g_km, AVG([Z (Wh/km)]) AS wh_per_km, AVG(Fc) AS fuel_l_100km, AVG([Ep (KW)]) AS power_kw, AVG([M (kg)]) AS mass_kg, AVG([Ec (cm3)]) AS displ_cm3 FROM [CO2Emission].[latest].[co2cars] WHERE MS='DE' AND  Ct='M1' AND Year = (SELECT MAX(Year) FROM [CO2Emission].[latest].[co2cars]) GROUP BY Mk, Cn, Ft, Year ORDER BY n DESC

co2cars_agg.json.url: sql:SELECT Mk, Cn, Ft, Year, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG([Ewltp (g/km)]) AS co2_wltp_g_km, AVG([Erwltp (g/km)]) AS co2_reduction_g_km, AVG([Z (Wh/km)]) AS wh_per_km, AVG(Fc) AS fuel_l_100km, AVG([Ep (KW)]) AS power_kw, AVG([M (kg)]) AS mass_kg, AVG([Ec (cm3)]) AS displ_cm3 FROM [CO2Emission].[latest].[co2cars] WHERE MS='DE' AND  Ct='M1' AND Year = (SELECT MAX(Year) FROM [CO2Emission].[latest].[co2cars]) GROUP BY Mk, Cn, Ft, Year ORDER BY n DESC
